description: Which ASPERN API is answering: the contract version (info.version, not the version of any plugin listing), the build, the environment, the contract hash (sha256 over paths and components; it moves only when the contract does), the operation counts from the approved inventory with every deprecated operation and its replacement, and the policy: within /v1 the contract only grows, a deprecated route keeps answering at least 180 days, and a change of meaning ships as a new field. Free; no key needed.
name: api_version

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

build.description: The deploy that answered; null where it is not stamped.

contractHash.description: sha256 over the document’s paths and components: moves only when the contract does.

documentSha256.description: sha256 of the whole document as served, build stamp included.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Which API version answered
